description: Fields from competitors/findings.jsonl that the contract has no place for, keyed by contract record_id / claim_id. Not read by the team validator or exporter.

luis:eu_challengers-F0001.statement: Reviewer states the ride is plush, smooth and comfortable, with air suspension available on higher trims.

luis:eu_challengers-F0002.statement: Reviewer states the 2,335 kg car feels heavy in corners and rough B-roads unsettle it.

luis:eu_challengers-F0003.statement: Reviewer states the steering offers little feel.

luis:eu_challengers-F0004.statement: Reviewer states the cabin is very quiet.

luis:eu_challengers-F0005.statement: Reviewer states a cold-weather motorway test returned 3.3 mi/kWh, projecting about 290 miles, roughly 120 miles short of the official 411-mile figure.

luis:eu_challengers-F0006.statement: Reviewer states DC charging reaches 310 kW with 10-80% in as little as 22 minutes, though few chargers can deliver that rate.

luis:eu_challengers-F0007.statement: Reviewer states the 14.5-inch portrait touchscreen and 9-inch driver display are crisp, and the Google-based system is quick and easy to use.

luis:eu_challengers-F0008.statement: Reviewer states there are no physical climate controls; physical controls are limited to station-skip buttons and a volume controller.

luis:eu_challengers-F0009.statement: Reviewer states some functions are fiddly because the glovebox release and mirror adjustment run through the touchscreen, and the menus are fiddly to set up.

luis:eu_challengers-F0010.statement: Reviewer praises the materials and fit and finish of the cabin.

luis:eu_challengers-F0011.statement: Reviewer states one test car had a minor clunk from a front seat.

luis:eu_challengers-F0012.statement: Reviewer states the front seats are well supported and comfortable.

luis:eu_challengers-F0013.statement: Reviewer states the high rear floor leaves rear passengers' legs raised with little under-thigh support, and rear headroom is only just adequate under the sloping roof.

luis:eu_challengers-F0014.statement: Reviewer flags poor rear visibility as a recurring criticism.

luis:eu_challengers-F0015.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:eu_challengers-F0015.statement: Reviewer states the driver assistance and safety systems are comprehensive, well integrated and unobtrusive.

luis:eu_challengers-F0016.statement: Reviewer rates the audio systems as excellent, with Bowers & Wilkins fitted on Ultra.

luis:eu_challengers-F0017.statement: Reviewer states all models are well equipped and even the Plus trim feels like a well-appointed luxury car.

luis:eu_challengers-F0018.statement: Reviewer's dimensions comparison shows the boot at 424 litres against 490 litres for the BMW i5.

luis:eu_challengers-F0019.statement: Reviewer criticises the short standard warranty of three years or 60,000 miles.

luis:eu_challengers-F0113.statement: Reviewer states the straight-line pace is addictive, especially for motorway overtakes.

luis:eu_challengers-F0114.statement: Reviewer states the car charges at up to 250 kW, about 30 minutes 10-80% on a V3 Supercharger.

luis:eu_challengers-F0115.statement: Reviewer states the Plaid corners flat but the steering lacks feel in every mode.

luis:eu_challengers-F0116.statement: Reviewer states the Plaid's seats are not very supportive, so occupants get thrown around on twisty roads.

luis:eu_challengers-F0117.statement: Reviewer states the indicator switches on the steering wheel do not help the user experience.

luis:eu_challengers-F0118.statement: Reviewer states build quality has improved, with most touched surfaces worthy of a roughly GBP 100,000 car.

luis:eu_challengers-F0119.statement: Reviewer states some external panel gaps are still large.

luis:eu_challengers-F0120.statement: Reviewer notes there is no Apple CarPlay or Android Auto.

luis:eu_challengers-F0121.statement: Reviewer states the gear stalk is gone and almost everything, including lights and wipers, runs through the touchscreen, with wipers buried in menus.

luis:eu_challengers-F0122.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:eu_challengers-F0122.statement: Reviewer calls Autopilot one of the smoothest and most advanced systems of its type, though the name is misleading and the driver must stay attentive.

luis:eu_challengers-F0123.statement: Reviewer highlights the 709-litre boot (1,739 litres with seats folded).

luis:eu_challengers-F0124.statement: Reviewer states the car is sold only in left-hand drive in the UK, which causes practical problems such as paying at car park machines.

luis:eu_challengers-F0125.statement: Reviewer names the BMW i7 as a rival luxury limousine that is quieter than the Model S.

luis:eu_challengers-F0144.statement: Reviewer states all versions are very quick, with precise accelerator response for smooth driving.

luis:eu_challengers-F0145.statement: Reviewer states the car is among the quietest EVs at motorway speeds.

luis:eu_challengers-F0146.statement: Reviewer states the Model 3 is less engaging to drive than the BMW i4.

luis:eu_challengers-F0147.statement: Reviewer states the steering lacks feedback.

luis:eu_challengers-F0148.statement: Reviewer states the suspension is firm with some patter at low speeds, though not uncomfortable.

luis:eu_challengers-F0149.statement: Reviewer states efficiency is class-leading, 4.4 mi/kWh in the RWD test.

luis:eu_challengers-F0150.statement: Reviewer highlights Supercharger access with favourable tariffs and straightforward billing.

luis:eu_challengers-F0151.statement: Reviewer praises the large, responsive 15.4-inch touchscreen with fast processing.

luis:eu_challengers-F0152.statement: Reviewer states the sat-nav plots charging stops en route and preconditions the battery.

luis:eu_challengers-F0153.statement: Reviewer states the lack of physical buttons hurts usability; the hazard switch sits by the mirror and the glovebox opens only via screen or voice.

luis:eu_challengers-F0154.statement: Reviewer states the cabin does not feel as solid or expensive as the BMW i4 or Mercedes CLA, despite improved fit and finish since the 2024 facelift.

luis:eu_challengers-F0155.statement: Reviewer lists ventilated seats among the car's strengths.

luis:eu_challengers-F0156.statement: Reviewer notes there is no Apple CarPlay or Android Auto.

luis:eu_challengers-F0157.vfc_level2: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology
luis:eu_challengers-F0157.statement: Reviewer states paying about GBP 7,000 for Full Self-Driving is not worthwhile because some features are not yet usable.

luis:eu_challengers-F0158.statement: Reviewer states the 594-litre boot with deep underfloor storage is big, against 470 litres for the BMW i4.

luis:eu_challengers-F0159.statement: Reviewer states the narrow saloon boot opening makes loading harder than in hatchbacks such as the BMW i4.

luis:eu_challengers-F0160.statement: Reviewer states the low rear seats give limited under-thigh support.

luis:eu_challengers-F0161.statement: Reviewer states even the base RWD is well equipped.

luis:eu_german-F0234.statement: Long-term tester states the charger-finding tools in both Android Auto and the car's own system worked well, showing charger speed and free plugs during a trip to France.

luis:eu_german-F0235.statement: Long-term tester reports rapid charging gained about 150 miles in a 20-minute stop and found French rapid chargers with bank-card payment almost seamless.

luis:eu_german-F0236.statement: Long-term tester reports 3.2 mi/kWh overall, matching the official 4.0 mi/kWh only in slow 50 mph traffic, and at 80 mph range fell from about 350 to about 260 miles (WLTP 443 miles).

luis:eu_german-F0237.statement: Long-term tester found the car composed and comfortable on motorways, with a smooth ride and stable tracking, though composed rather than fun.

luis:eu_german-F0238.statement: Long-term tester found the boot very large for a family of four on holiday.

luis:eu_german-F0239.statement: Long-term tester states the parcel shelf must be detached before loading a full boot, to avoid bending it when closing the tailgate.

luis:eu_german-F0240.statement: Long-term tester states rear legroom is limited because the bench sits low, forcing taller passengers to bend their knees, and under-thigh support could be better.

luis:eu_german-F0241.statement: Long-term tester states the voice control did not understand his commands.

luis:eu_german-F0242.statement: Long-term tester reports the touch-to-open charging flaps kept opening while the car was being washed.

luis:eu_german-F0243.statement: Long-term tester praises the Malpelo Blue paint and the estate's shape.

luis:eu_german-F0252.statement: Long-term tester finds the EV-specific front, with blanked grille and a body-coloured panel between the headlights, less appealing than the petrol/hybrid A6.

luis:eu_german-F0253.statement: Long-term tester states the black plastic sill panels look cheap and pick up fingerprints.
